issue.title: skills: native list/status/targets for every library state and the skills MCP tools
issue.body:
## Context
The Rust CLI still routes to the Go binary through `run_go_fallback` (`rust/symbrain-cli/src/lib.rs`) whenever a module's `requires_go_fallback` returns true. `skills_cli.rs` sends to Go: populated `skills list` (metadata/created/modified/per-target installs/last-used table), `skills status` with dynamic config or non-default scopes/targets, `skills targets` with arguments, and other verbs. The skills MCP tools (`internal/skills/mcptools`, symskills) are Go. Open defects to fix in Rust: #621 (render drift/permanent stale), #490 (confined symlink rendering), #476 (bounded bundle parsing), #457 (concurrent registry updates).

## Scope
- Port the remaining CLI shapes and the MCP tools with Go-oracle fixtures; fix #621/#490/#476/#457 as documented deviations.
- Remove `skills_cli::requires_go_fallback`.

## Acceptance
- Skills CLI and MCP differentials pass on native three-OS CI; no `skills` path reaches Go.

---
**Part of:** #731
**Agent notes:** work in an isolated worktree off current `main`; read `AGENTS.md` and the migration ledger first. Until Go is removed, parity evidence must come from real Go-oracle fixtures generated in disposable HOME/XDG roots (no operator credentials). Update the ledger/contract-matrix rows touched by this issue in the same PR. Skipped, zero-case or cross-compiled-only runs are not evidence.
